methodology: Three sequential runs per page/device/phase; median per metric. Same Chrome/Lighthouse configuration. No simultaneous browser QA. Laboratory results, not field Core Web Vitals. CPU performance and network varied; warnings retained. Product is unchanged by the last home-only commit.
